definition_and_formula: SUM project latest approved forecast EAC
grain_and_quality_control: one version per project as-of date

definition_and_formula: SUM approved project budget minus SUM forecast EAC
grain_and_quality_control: consistent project scope and currency

definition_and_formula: (SUM approved budget minus SUM EAC) / SUM approved budget
grain_and_quality_control: zero-budget projects excluded or flagged

definition_and_formula: SUM EAC / SUM commissioned IT MW
grain_and_quality_control: capacity-weighted aggregation; MW greater than zero

definition_and_formula: Forecast finish minus approved baseline finish
grain_and_quality_control: positive indicates late; date baseline version controlled

definition_and_formula: Milestones completed on time divided by milestones due
grain_and_quality_control: milestones due by reporting cutoff only

definition_and_formula: Milestones completed divided by milestones planned due by cutoff
grain_and_quality_control: do not include undued future milestones

definition_and_formula: Count open critical risks with due date before as-of date
grain_and_quality_control: risk log must have explicit owner and due date

definition_and_formula: Projects crossing approved risk criteria divided by active projects
grain_and_quality_control: criteria versioned and transparent

definition_and_formula: As-of date minus latest validated status update date
grain_and_quality_control: record approved submission not merely edit time

definition_and_formula: Non-null required reporting fields divided by expected required fields
grain_and_quality_control: define denominator by project snapshot

definition_and_formula: Published KPIs with approved definitions divided by all published KPIs
grain_and_quality_control: owner and definition version required

definition_and_formula: Operations project actuals minus Finance GL actuals
grain_and_quality_control: match cutoff currency accounting scope and posted status

definition_and_formula: Successful scheduled refreshes divided by scheduled refreshes
grain_and_quality_control: exclude intentional cancellations only by documented policy

definition_and_formula: Failed production pipelines divided by production runs
grain_and_quality_control: log retry policy and exception handling

definition_and_formula: Requests triaged within agreed SLA divided by requests requiring triage
grain_and_quality_control: agreed submission completeness and working calendar

definition_and_formula: As-of date minus request created date for unresolved requests
grain_and_quality_control: include waiting/on-hold state separately

definition_and_formula: Release date minus work-start date
grain_and_quality_control: use same start and end state across work types

definition_and_formula: Accepted completed requests during reporting period
grain_and_quality_control: exclude canceled or reopened work pending reacceptance

definition_and_formula: Count active requests not yet completed
grain_and_quality_control: define in-progress states

definition_and_formula: Production defects attributed to released work divided by releases
grain_and_quality_control: report absolute counts too

definition_and_formula: Deliverables accepted first review divided by deliverables reviewed
grain_and_quality_control: avoid treating no response as accepted

definition_and_formula: Completed scheduled one-on-ones divided by planned one-on-ones
grain_and_quality_control: aggregate without publishing personal employee information

definition_and_formula: Team members with active development goals divided by eligible team members
grain_and_quality_control: do not publish identifiable HR information

definition_and_formula: Leadership or retrospective actions closed by agreed due date divided by actions due
grain_and_quality_control: report cohort and follow-up owner

definition_and_formula: Planned delivery effort by category divided by total planned team effort
grain_and_quality_control: planning tool not individual productivity ranking
